purpose: Freeze the raw source boundary and sign/coverage rules required before any distributed-lag exchange-rate pass-through estimation for Romania.

exchange_rate.concept: Monthly average Romanian leu per euro ECB reference exchange rate
exchange_rate.source_coverage_evidence: ECB Data Portal reports monthly coverage beginning in January 1999.

inflation.concept: Romania all-items Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices
inflation.coverage_note: Eurostat catalogue identifies monthly HICP index coverage beginning in 1996; exact Romania vintage must be retained when materialised.

external_price_control_screen.preferred_dataset: Eurostat sts_inpi_m — Import prices in industry, monthly data
external_price_control_screen.concept: Monthly transaction-price development of imported industrial goods purchased by domestic residents.
external_price_control_screen.reason: Eurostat states that euro-area countries are required to transmit industrial import prices, while only some non-euro EU/EFTA countries provide them. Dataset existence therefore does not prove a Romanian series.
external_price_control_screen.rule: Do not choose a substitute external-price control after observing model fit. If Romanian import-price coverage is unavailable, freeze an alternative external-price control in a new contract before opening outcomes.

transformation_boundary.fx_change_candidate: log difference of the monthly-average RON-per-EUR series
transformation_boundary.rationale: Monthly log change, year-on-year inflation and seasonally adjusted transforms answer different questions. The transform and lag horizon must be preregistered only after raw-source completeness and revision properties are frozen, not chosen from fit.

required_before_estimation: Retain the exact ECB EXR monthly RON/EUR series with provider key, vintage metadata and raw-source hash.
Retain the exact Eurostat Romania HICP CP00 monthly series with dataset dimensions, vintage metadata and raw-source hash.
Establish whether Romania has a definitionally suitable exact industrial import-price series in sts_inpi_m; record a pass or explicit unavailability.
If the preferred import-price control is unavailable, preregister a replacement external-price control before inspecting pass-through fit.
Freeze inflation transform, lag horizon, estimation start date/regime boundary, structural-selection window and untouched evaluation window before estimation.
prohibited_shortcuts: Use end-of-period exchange rates when the frozen driver is monthly average without a new source-boundary contract.
Switch between CPI and HICP after seeing model performance.
Select monthly versus year-on-year inflation transform from holdout fit.
Choose lag length after opening untouched evaluation data.
Treat correlation between RON depreciation and inflation as causal pass-through.
Import pre-inflation-targeting or pre-current-regime coefficients as current Romanian parameters.
Silently substitute euro-area import prices for a missing Romanian import-price series.
source_materialisation_gate.pass_effect: Authorises a separately preregistered structural-selection cycle against autoregressive and external-price baselines; no causal or System Dynamics activation follows automatically.
source_materialisation_gate.fail_effect: Retain the mechanism as CANDIDATE and do not estimate an under-controlled distributed-lag equation.
